articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-Bench over its predecessor, with significantly reduced hallucination rates on factual retrieval tasks. The model is available through the API with a new structured-output guarantee mode aimed at enterprise integrations.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored a verified 92% on a curated set of International Mathematical Olympiad problems, surpassing all prior AI systems. The model uses a novel chain-of-verification architecture that cross-checks intermediate proof steps against a formal theorem prover. Researchers note this represents a meaningful step toward AI systems that can assist with open mathematical conjectures.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Deploys Humanoid Workers at BMW's Spartanburg Plant at Scale
articles.summary: Figure announced that over 200 of its Figure 03 humanoid robots are now operating across multiple assembly lines at BMW's South Carolina manufacturing facility, handling tasks from parts kitting to quality inspection. The robots leverage on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation without reprogramming. BMW reports a 17% throughput improvement in pilot zones with a safety record matching conventional automation.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Demonstrates Autonomous Disaster Response in DARPA Field Trials
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics' fully electric Atlas robot completed a series of DARPA-supervised disaster response scenarios, autonomously navigating collapsed structures, opening doors and valves, and carrying 40 kg payloads over rubble. The system combines LiDAR-based real-time 3D reconstruction with a foundation model for semantic scene understanding to make navigation decisions. DARPA officials described it as the most capable autonomous disaster-response platform tested to date.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Monitoring Framework for Enterprise Autonomous Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new open-source framework for monitoring and constraining autonomous AI agents in enterprise environments, building on its constitutional AI research. The system provides real-time policy enforcement, audit logging, and automatic escalation when agents encounter edge cases outside their sanctioned behavior boundaries. Early adopters in financial services report it significantly reduces the risk surface of deploying agentic AI workflows in production.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed it has started high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at its Kaohsiung fab, approximately one quarter ahead of its original roadmap. The node uses gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery, yielding a 25% performance gain and 35% power reduction over N2. Apple and Nvidia are among the first customers expected to tape out designs on the process for late-2027 products.

articles.title: Meta Unveils Orion AR Glasses Consumer Edition with All-Day Battery and Real-Time AI Assistant
articles.summary: Meta officially announced the consumer version of its Orion augmented reality glasses, featuring a sleek form factor under 70 grams, a full-day battery via a belt-mounted compute puck, and a holographic waveguide display with a 70-degree field of view. The glasses ship with a deeply integrated Llama-4-powered AI assistant capable of real-time contextual awareness, object identification, and live translation. Pre-orders begin in early 2027 at $1,299.

articles.title: Toyota Research Institute Demonstrates Dexterous Bi-Manual Robot Learning from 50 Human Demonstrations
articles.summary: Toyota Research Institute published results showing its diffusion-policy-based robotic manipulation system can learn complex bi-manual tasks — such as folding garments and assembling multi-part objects — from as few as 50 human teleoperation demonstrations. The approach generalizes across object geometries not seen during training, a notable improvement over prior methods requiring thousands of examples. TRI plans to integrate the system into its home-assistant robot prototype for trials in elder-care facilities in 2027.
